articles.title: This Robot Can Guess What to Do Next!
articles.summary: What if a robot could figure things out like you do? A scientist named Yen-Ling Kuo taught robots to make smart guesses when they face something new. Her idea won a big award and could make robots way more helpful.

articles.title: A Baby Hippo Named 'Breadroll' Is Stealing Hearts!
articles.summary: A tiny pygmy hippo was born at Zoo Berlin, and her name is Brötchen—German for 'breadroll.' She's already a star online, but her wild cousins are in trouble. Only about 2,500 adult pygmy hippos are left in West Africa.

articles.title: Rescuers Free a Young Whale Tangled in Fishing Line!
articles.summary: A young humpback whale was stuck in ropes near Cape Cod. A special rescue team cut it free using a knife on a 30-foot pole. The whale is hurt but should heal. Over 300,000 whales and dolphins die from fishing gear every year.
